text:
maria: Hey, quick heads-up — p95 for /v1/generate spiked in the dashboard after yesterday's routing policy change. Looks like the route fallback to cpu-small kicked in for some tenants.
sam: hmm, did quotas cause retries? or was it just capacity fallback?
maria: initial check: sample_count dropped in the rolled-up metric and the p95 jump aligns w/ the fallback window.
vikram: can you paste the console view? maybe the sampling origin changed from "edge" to "fallback".
maria: screenshot pasted — but here's the raw query i ran in debug: ```SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) AS p95, count(*) AS samples, origin FROM latency_events WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' GROUP BY origin``` 
sam: ok. two issues: 1) the dashboard merges origins without highlighting weight changes 2) the UI doesn't show sample_count next to percentiles which makes this confusing.
jen: +1. For runbook, we should have a checklist: a) check sample origin distribution b) check route weights c) look at model-variant fallbacks d) inspect retry counts e) verify aggregator compression/tdigest params.
maria: i drafted a short runbook in the thread: ```1) open console -> endpoint breakdown -> toggle "origin" 2) run the percentile query with sample counts 3) cross-check route-weight change window vs spike 4) look at quota/fallback logs in routing-service 5) check kvcache hit ratio``` 
vikram: also add: check whether we used smoothing window of 5m vs 1m; smoothing can mask step changes and nudge p95.
sam: UX ask: can console show a small badge on percentiles when sample_count < N or when origins shift > X% ?
jen: i think we already have a badge prototype in /dev/design. telemetry-bot: note — we emit sample_count and origin tags but frontend currently drops origin when count < 5 for privacy.
maria: that's the root of confusion — low sample redaction + merging made the remaining samples look slower.
vikram: proposal: internal API change to always surface sample_count and a low-sample warning flag to the console, even if origin redacted. Backend teams: any objections?
sam: no objections, but need to add rate limit to metadata to avoid cardinality blowup.
jen: action items: maria to file a tiny RFC for the API flag; sam to add frontend badge mock; vikram to add runbook steps to ops-runbooks repo; i'll link the prototype.
maria: filing RFC now — will include example payloads: ```{ "p95": 320, "samples": 7, "sample_origin": "redacted", "low_sample_warning": true }``` 
sam: cool. timeline? can we do a hotfix badge for the next minor release? jen: yes, skip gating, this is UX-only and behind a feature flag.
vikram: i'll add the runbook as `eng-platform/latency-investigation-guides/low-sample-variance.md` and include the commands.
maria: thanks all. if someone hits this again ping me and reference this thread.
sam: :thumbsup:
jen: :heart:
